Subject: Recap: deployment options & immediate network asks

Hi Alice — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap + immediate network asks so we can keep momentum toward a Private VPC deployment.

Summary of customer requirements we discussed:
- Primary: Data residency + strict audit trail — Private VPC is preferred.
- Traffic pattern: mostly request/response API calls (low per-request token volumes), peak qps ~60 across US regions.
- Compliance: SOC2 + customer-specific retention controls needed.

Deployment options we reviewed (trade-offs):
- Hosted API: fastest onboarding, no infra work; doesn't meet your control/audit needs.
- Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput, still Redwood-managed network; could be interim if you need predictable SLA before Private VPC.
- Private VPC (recommended): full-network isolation with either AWS PrivateLink or VPC Peering. PrivateLink typically simplifies NAT/firewall requirements; peering can give lower egress cost but needs peering route tables and potential routing changes.

Immediate asks from your side (what we need to qualify and schedule network ops):
1) Confirm preferred connectivity pattern: AWS PrivateLink or VPC Peering? If undecided, say so and we'll propose a recommendation.
2) Provide your canonical VPC CIDR(s) or egress IP ranges (if you use NAT) — see attached \"netfin-cidr-list.txt\" for a starting template we sent.
3) Identify the network contact(s) to join a 30-min technical call next week (network/infra engineer + security).
4) Any outbound firewall rules that would block TLS egress to AWS endpoints or to our designated PrivateLink interface endpoints.
5) KMS / certificate constraints: do you require customer-managed keys (bring-your-own KMS) for logs or model traces?

Attachments I shared: redwood-private-deploy-playbook-v1.pdf (high-level checklist) and ops-runbook-template.md (what we need from network ops).

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm PrivateLink and send CIDRs by end of week, we can schedule a network call and provide a formal runbook within 3 business days.
- If you prefer peering, we’ll need a little more time to map routing and propose a fallback plan.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally with a runbook draft and route assignments.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
